title: Tell al-Mashhad
description: Archaeological site in Jordan, located approximately 10 km northwest of Madaba. The site shows signs of primary occupation during the Iron Age II (900-600 BCE).

properties.description: Point representing the approximate center point of the visible remains at Tell al-Mashhad; coordinate location specified in Benedettucci 2022.
